  "description": "Candidates are required to complete a 3–6 month training period at the Cần Thơ Warehouse before relocating to a warehouse near HCMC.\n\n* Take overall responsibility for daily warehouse operations, including receiving, put-away, storage, picking, packing, and outbound activities.\n* Manage and control warehouse inventory accuracy through proper stock management, cycle counts, periodic stocktakes, and data reconciliation.\n* Monitor inbound and outbound operations to ensure timely processing, order fulfillment, and on-time delivery.\n* Develop and optimize warehouse layout, storage capacity, and product allocation to maximize space utilization and operational efficiency.\n* Establish, implement, and continuously improve warehouse Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and ensure compliance across the warehouse team.\n* Lead, manage, and develop warehouse staff, ensuring productivity, discipline, work quality, and compliance with occupational health and safety requirements.\n* Set and monitor warehouse KPIs, identify operational gaps, and take corrective actions to improve productivity and service levels.\n* Coordinate closely with Supply Chain, Fleet, Operations, and other relevant departments to ensure smooth and efficient end-to-end operations.\n* Ensure the accuracy and timely completion of warehouse reports, including inventory status, inbound/outbound records, stock discrepancies, and operational performance.\n* Take ownership of warehouse safety, security, cleanliness, and compliance with company policies and relevant regulations.\n* Investigate and resolve operational issues, inventory discrepancies, and other warehouse-related problems in a timely manner.\n* Analyze warehouse performance and identify opportunities to improve processes, reduce operating costs, and enhance overall efficiency.\n* Manage manpower planning and ensure sufficient staffing to meet business and operational requirements.\n* Provide regular reports and operational updates to management and recommend solutions for warehouse improvement.\n* Perform other duties and projects as assigned by management.",
  "requirements_text": "Yêu cầu:\n5 năm kinh nghiệm chuyên môn  5 năm kinh nghiệm quản lý  Đại Học trở lên  Nam\n\nYêu cầu ứng viên\n* Bachelor's degree or above in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Warehouse Management, or a related field.\n* At least **5 – 8 years of experience in warehouse operations, logistics, or supply chain** , with solid experience in warehouse management.\n* Proven experience in managing and leading warehouse teams, preferably in a retail, FMCG, distribution, or high-volume warehouse environment.\n* Strong practical knowledge of inventory management, warehouse operations, inbound/outbound processes, and stock control.\n* Experience with WMS or other warehouse management systems is an advantage.\n* Strong leadership, team management, coordination, and problem-solving skills.\n* Strong ability to analyze operational data and identify areas for improvement.\n* Good communication skills in **English and/or Chinese**.\n* Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially **Excel**.\n* Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and make effective decisions in a fast-paced environment.\n\nKiến thức ngành\nKho vận, Bán lẻ - Hàng tiêu dùng - FMCG, Thực phẩm / Đồ uống"
